title: 02_fidelity_detail
interpretation: Per-observable fidelity matrix (left): max relative error vs the exact reference for COPASI (vs Tellurium), proto_valve and the event-driven hybrid (both vs the full model). COPASI agrees everywhere (<5e-4); proto_valve and the hybrid are identical on every observable (~6% on CO/SVR from the dropped per-beat layer) EXCEPT blood pathogen, which is exact for proto_valve (events in SBML) but a ~20% transient for the hybrid (events in the composition layer, tick-quantized infection start). Right: the blood-pathogen infection curve (all methods track) and the pulsatile MAP detail.
